# staticform_user_settings (Resource)

The authenticated account's settings. This is a singleton: one per account. Destroying it only removes it from state; it does not reset the account. Requires the `User.Settings.Get` and `User.Settings.Update` permissions. The failure, email quota and storage warning toggles are per-event notification preferences: use `staticform_notification_preferences` with the event keys `product.SubmitActionFailed`, `product.EmailQuotaWarning` and `product.StorageWarning`. Email overage no longer exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "staticform_user_settings" "account" {
  submission_overview_email_frequency = "Weekly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `submission_overview_email_frequency` (String) Submission summary cadence: `Off`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
